function.name: search_regulation
function.description: Full-text search over the regulation library. Returns up to 5 matching provisions, each with its provision_id, document_id, title and a short snippet. Use get_provision to read one in full.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. a document title, a defined term or a topic.

regulator.description: Optional regulator code to filter by, e.g. SEC, FDIC, HMT, CMA.

document_id.description: Optional: search within one document. Only use a document_id given in the question or returned by an earlier search; never make one up.

function.name: get_provision
function.description: Read one provision in full, with its document's title and publication date.

provision_id.description: A provision_id from search_regulation or list_sections, shaped '<document_id>#<number>', e.g. 'us_corpus:7069#2'. A document_id alone is not a provision_id.

function.name: list_sections
function.description: List a document's provisions in order (provision_id and section heading). Use it when you know the document_id and need to see what the document contains.
